description:
Current scope: User scope correction: PR5 delivers the foundation. Mattermost adapter publication/pinning and full real-provider partial-upload verification move to PR6 with AttachDocuments (zaq-pi3.7), using existing zaq-h2i.4.3. This supersedes earlier descriptions/comments making a published Mattermost fix a PR5 prerequisite. PR5 still completes chat boundary plumbing, SMTP, Channels.Api wiring, Channels -> Engine reporting and the grouped-failure modal. Use controlled external adapter-boundary fixtures for unavailable operations while exercising real internal planning/preparation/execution/reporting; verify current packages fail safely where unsupported. Never advertise unsupported production capabilities, guess partial-upload identities, edit ignored deps or substitute local dependency pins. Full provider compatibility must be verified in PR6 before claiming Mattermost attachment readiness. This scope correction does not authorize commits, pushes or dependency publication.

Functional specifications / files: inspect mix.exs/mix.lock and actual owning adapter sources; record current adapter availability; defer the published Mattermost prerequisite to PR6. Verify declarations and upload/prepare/send/edit functions together, real request/receipt shapes, attachment-edit capability, optional unknown limits, selected-connection isolation and no fabricated support. Do not edit ignored deps or import old dependency pins wholesale. If dependency integration is needed, change only reviewed compatible pins with source evidence; publication is not authorized.
Evidence: current Jido Chat 1.2.1, Mattermost 93025d5205e070eebbecf89e539d32bdf1fde3ff; same revision inspected in PR4 deps lacks file_requirements/prepare_upload/upload_prepared. Reference uses Jido f17679337a9975bee43b9540cb08ac5cfc12b86a and Mattermost 98cd98c8f4171f2baef3177dfdeb193c607d941f. Current Swoosh 1.27.0/gen_smtp 1.3.0 match reference pins but wire-byte compatibility still needs executable proof.
Tests before implementation: foundation contract fixtures for prepare/upload/send/edit at the external adapter boundary; real current-package unsupported behavior; absent declarations controlled fallback; SMTP encoded-byte framing/no-retry probe. Confirm no global telemetry leak of bytes.
Branches: simulated supported adapter contract plus actual unavailable/unsupported adapters (including Telegram), exact SMTP stack. Do not gate PR5 on unrelated WebWidget work.
Mocking: external adapter operations unavailable in pinned packages may use explicit test fixtures; internal services remain real. SMTP uses real encoding and local submission capture.
Documentation: compatibility evidence and supported/unsupported status here and Channels guide.
Action reuse: reuse existing adapter APIs/SDK, shared capability_snapshot and TransportRequirements.resolve; no new resolver/Action. Adapter owns transport and declarations; ZAQ owns plan/execution and settings. This gate must pass before chat integration.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

PR #970 impact audit (head 9d0fc08cf, included in PR5 81629c90a): no change to resolver/bridge execution contracts or file adapter pins. New FileSettings.validation_capabilities/1 and BO CapabilitySnapshot helper are save-feedback/presentation APIs, not alternative runtime requirements sources. Keep using the selected committed outbound connector + normalized runtime snapshot + TransportRequirements.resolve/2. Compatibility proof must preserve explicit false policy, fixed/configurable ceilings, optional unresolved values and unavailable versus successful-empty snapshots. Review-fix commit adds no missing Mattermost file operations; zaq-h2i.4.3 remains required for PR6 real Mattermost verification, not PR5 completion.
